title: Brazilian Garlicky Bowl
description: A flavorful vegetarian bowl dish inspired by Brazilian cuisine, packed with garlicky goodness and fresh ingredients.

ingredients.name: Roasted sweet potatoes
ingredients.notes: roast in the oven at 400°F (200°C) for 20-25 minutes

ingredients.name: Sauteed kale
ingredients.notes: saute in olive oil until wilted

instructions: Roast sweet potatoes in the oven for 20-25 minutes.
Cook Brazilian garlicky rice according to package instructions.
Cook kissed black beans according to package instructions.
Saute chopped kale in olive oil until wilted.
Assemble the bowl by placing roasted sweet potatoes, cooked rice, black beans, and sauteed kale in a bowl.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve.
